name: Hayakawa Kiko
source:
Kiko plays the piccolo in the school's Brass Band Club. She's a clumsy girl, prone to tripping as well as forgetting where she's put things. A fervent believer of [url=/c98614]Hajime[/url]. Kiko is in the same class as her friend [url=/c98237]Kanae[/url], who she calls "Miyo-chan".

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
